scripts.generate: nxgt-graphql-scalars typedefs --out && nxgt-graphql-validation typedefs --out && graphql-codegen --config codegen.ts
scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d --wait mongo redis mailpit minio && docker compose up -d media-bucket && docker compose --profile init run --rm mongo-init
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun build src/server.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist --minify --sourcemap=linked --external @napi-rs/canvas --external pdfjs-dist
scripts.build:scripts: bun build src/scripts/pdf-preview-check.ts src/scripts/bootstrap.ts --target=bun --root src/scripts --outdir=dist/scripts --minify --external @napi-rs/canvas --external pdfjs-dist
scripts.verify: bun run generate && bun run schema:print --check && bun run schema:print:public --check && bun run check:ci && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.verify:pr: bun run generate && bun run schema:print --check && bun run schema:print:public --check && bun run check:ci && bun run typecheck && bun run test:affected origin/develop && bun run build
